name: auris
description: Live captions that match the audio, for language learning

scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign: npm run build && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --channel unlisted
scripts.source: mkdir -p artifacts && git archive --format=zip -o artifacts/source.zip HEAD
scripts.submit: npm run build && npm run source && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --channel listed --amo-metadata amo/metadata.json --upload-source-code artifacts/source.zip
